author: Wanda Wilson Dooley
text: Are you carrying the phone on your person? If you walk off to do something and walk out of range of your phone, it will lose the signal.And you'll often have to fiddle with it.A bit to get the signal back.

author: Suzanne Suzanne
text: Turn Bluetooth off and on then turn your phone off and back on sensor will reset, then scan and it should catch up , scan the sensor every 8 hours I did before bed and when I wake up.
